item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor, Prostate cancer inequality: too much PSA testing, too little inclusive research Reynolds and colleagues highlight the urgent need to understand ethnic inequalities in prostate cancer screening and outcomes. item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor, The REVEAL guidance recently published in BMJ offers a timely framework for identifying prior evidence before initiating new clinical trials.¹ Its core message is welcome: no new study should proceed without systematic consideration of what is already known. item.title: Quantitative evidence of language bias in paper mill detection models
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor We commend Scancar et al. for addressing the critical issue of research integrity in cancer research1.
